item.text: [{"task_id":"ac6f9922","source_lines":["def spans(active):","    result = []","    current = []","    for i in range(len(active)):","        if active[i]:","            current.append(i)","        elif current:","            result.append(current)","            current = []","    if current:","        result.append(current)","    return result","","def run(params, grid, demos):","    corner_row = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    corner_col = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    minimum_count = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    background = int(grid[corner_row, corner_col])","    points = np.argwhere(grid != background)","    if len(points) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    top = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","    bottom = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","    left = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","    right = int(np.max(points[:, 1]))","    separator = int(grid[top, left])","    region = grid[top:bottom + 1, left:right + 1]","    occupied = region != separator","    rows = spans(np.sum(occupied, axis=1) >= minimum_count)","    columns = spans(np.sum(occupied, axis=0) >= minimum_count)","    if len(rows) == 0 or len(columns) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    output = np.full((len(rows), len(columns)), background, dtype=int)","    for r in range(len(rows)):","        for c in range(len(columns)):","            block = region[rows[r][0]:rows[r][-1] + 1, columns[c][0]:columns[c][-1] + 1]","            colors = block[(block != background) & (block != separator)]","            if len(colors) > 0:","                output[r, c] = int(colors[0])","    return output"],"shapes":{"geometry":[3]},"params":{"geometry":[0,0,1]},"rationale":"Read the background from the parameter-selected corner and identify the enclosing separator region. A tensor-controlled minimum occupancy of one detects contiguous rows and columns containing compartments.
